news.title: Viet Nam maintain top spot in Southeast Asian women’s football
news.lede: Viet Nam’s women’s national team have maintained their position at 37th in the world, unchanged from the previous edition of the rankings. Under head coach Hoang Van Phuc, the team remain among Asia’s leading sides. In the continental rankings, Viet Nam are sixth, behind Japan, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Australia, the Republic of Korea and China. They continue to lead the Southeast Asian region.

news.title: Nigeria beat Puerto Rico to revive U17 World Cup hopes
news.lede: Oluwakemi Adegbuyi broke the deadlock in the 25th minute before substitute Precious Oscar sealed the victory three minutes into stoppage time. The Flamingos dominated proceedings but struggled to convert several opportunities, with Queen Joseph, captain Chidera Chidi and Tosin Rafiu all failing to find the target. Adegbuyi also came close to doubling her tally, while Puerto Rico threatened through Mia Colon, Megan Rivera and Caroline Rivera. The victory revived Nigeria's qualification hopes following their 2-1 defeat to Poland.

news.title: Uzbekistan Women Set World Cup Play-Off Schedule
news.lede: Tashkent, Uzbekistan (UzDaily.uz) — Uzbekistan’s women’s national football team will play three matches in Morocco in the play-off tournament for a place at the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil, the Uzbekistan Football Association said. The team will face Papua New Guinea on 28 November at 9:30 p.m., Ghana on 1 December at 9:30 p.m. and South Africa on 5 December at 10 p.m. All three matches will be held at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Morocco. Anvar Umarov is the founder and editor-in-chief of UzDaily, a leading business and news publication covering Uzbekistan and Central Asia.

news.title: Gianni Infantino issued public apology as statement on FIFA president's salary claims made
news.lede: FIFA have reaffirmed its belief that there is a concerted effort to undermine President Gianni Infantino, after an apology was issued over claims the world governing body boss was drawing a second salary. The governing body of world football criticised the 'damaging report'. Infantino has come under increased scrutiny after his proposal to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors. The Swiss football politician has so far withstood a number of calls to stand down from his position ahead of the presidential election next year.

news.title: Man United warned against hiring World Cup manager if Carrick is sacked
news.lede: That is according to talkSPORT's chief football correspondent Alex Crook amid growing pressure on manager Michael Carrick. The Red Devils boss has endured a poor start to the new season following his permanent appointment in May. Carrick was rewarded for securing a third place finish and Champions League qualification with a two-year deal at Old Trafford. However, his side have won just twice in 10 matches in all competitions this term ahead of Wednesday's clash with Como.

news.title: Ghana Joins Nigeria In Lamentations Over U17 National Team's World Cup Absence, Due To Dwindling Form
news.lede: Nigeria’s fellow English-speaking West African neighbour, Ghana, has joined their eternal rivals in lamentations over another FIFA U17 World Cup absence, due to the dwindling form of their cadet team, Black Starlets. Sports247 reports that, in an uncanny shift from the famous ‘jollof rivalry’ between both countries, Ghana and Nigeria now share the same ignominious absence from the continental and global spotlight of under-17 football. This follows the inability of both teams to advance from the ongoing West African Football Union (WAFU)-B U17 Championship in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, where Nigeria failed to reach the semi-finals, and Ghana could not make the final.
